Package de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix

Class Matrix.Factory

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix.Factory
Enclosing class:
Matrix
public static final class Matrix.Factory extends Object
Static constructors. All paths now produce DenseMatrix instances (column-major double[]) -- kept under Matrix.Factory.* so existing call sites compile unchanged during the staged migration.

    • vertCat

      public static DenseMatrix vertCat(Matrix... parts)
      Vertical concatenation: stack the input matrices on top of each other. All inputs must have the same column count.
      Parameters:
      parts - matrices to stack (in order, from top to bottom)
      Returns:
      a fresh DenseMatrix containing the stacked rows
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if column counts differ
